row.notes: (ObfSpline *s, uint x, uint y): appends a 32-byte obfuscated vertex {x^k1,k1,y^k2,k2} with fresh MT19937 keys (global MT 0x146108c00 seeded from QPC), grows vector s+8..+0x18 (allocator s[0]), then recomputes the min-y vertex and stores it re-obfuscated in s+0x20/+0x40. Anti-tamper: steering-assist curve values are never stored in clear. Caller: Car_PadAssist_LoadSteeringSplines.
